:::{#def-test-error}
#### Test error

The **test error** of a [prediction rule](#def-prediction-rule) $\fitted$
fitted to a [training set](#def-training-set) $\trainset$
is its mean [loss](#def-observation-loss) $\obsloss{\iobs}$
on the [test set](#def-test-set), indexed by $\testidx$:

$$
\testerr \eqdef \avgon{\testidx} \obsloss{\iobs}.
$$ {#eq-test-error}

:::
